surfaces.name: Telegram bot interface (messages, replies, topics, inline buttons) served by the takopi process
takopi CLI (onboarding, init, config, doctor, plugins) and the process that bridges Telegram to local agent CLIs

claims.answer: No client of its own: the interface is Telegram (any Telegram app or web client, including phones) talking to a takopi process on the user machine, plus a takopi CLI for setup and running. No desktop app, web UI or editor extension. The bridge runs where Python 3.14 and uv run (OS independent).

evidence.title: banteg/takopi repository
evidence.finding: MIT license, 1,059 stars on 2026-11-16, last push 2026-05-25, not archived, 52 open issues and pull requests.

evidence.title: takopi v0.23.4 release
evidence.finding: Release v0.23.4 published 2026-05-25; also published to PyPI as takopi 0.23.4.

evidence.title: takopi on PyPI
evidence.finding: Package takopi 0.23.4 with documentation, homepage, issues and repository links to takopi.dev and GitHub.

evidence.title: takopi readme
evidence.locator: features, requirements, install, setup, usage, plugins
evidence.finding: Telegram bridge for codex, claude code, opencode and pi with projects, git worktrees, stateless resume, progress streaming, parallel runs with per-session queue, voice notes, file transfer, topics and existing subscriptions; requires uv, Python 3.14 and an engine on PATH.

evidence.title: MIT License
evidence.finding: MIT license text.

evidence.title: pyproject.toml
evidence.finding: Python package with anyio, httpx, openai, pydantic, typer, watchfiles; MIT classifier; OS Independent; Python 3.14.

evidence.title: changelog
evidence.finding: Releases through v0.23.4 (2026-05-25): Codex app-server default, steer and cancel buttons, reasoning overrides, retry of Telegram network errors.

evidence.title: Configuration reference
evidence.finding: Config at ~/.takopi/takopi.toml: bot token, chat id, allowed_user_ids, session_mode, voice, topics, files, projects with worktrees_dir and worktree_base, plugins.

evidence.title: Commands and directives
evidence.locator: Message directives, Telegram in-chat commands, CLI
evidence.finding: Directives /engine, /project and @branch, in-chat commands /cancel /agent /model /reasoning /trigger /file /topic /ctx /new, and CLI commands init, chat-id, doctor, plugins.

evidence.title: Worktrees how-to
evidence.finding: @branch runs a task in a dedicated git worktree under worktrees_dir; ctx footer carries context forward.

evidence.title: Worktree implementation
evidence.finding: Runs git worktree add (with -b for a new branch) under the project worktrees directory and refuses a non-worktree path.

evidence.title: Takopi specification
evidence.finding: Resume tokens and lines, normalized events, per-thread serialization, scheduling, progress and cancellation, lockfile for a single instance.

evidence.title: Telegram transport
evidence.locator: Incoming messages, Trigger mode, Chat sessions, Forum topics, Outbox, Rate limiting
evidence.finding: Voice transcription, mentions-only trigger mode, chat sessions stored in telegram_chat_sessions_state.json, forum topics, outbox with rate limiting and backoff.

evidence.title: Topics
evidence.finding: Forum topics bind a repo and branch with their own session and default engine for team chats.

evidence.title: File transfer
evidence.finding: Optional /file put and /file get with upload and download size limits and a deny glob list.

evidence.title: Voice notes
evidence.finding: Optional voice transcription through an OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint.

evidence.title: Schedule tasks
evidence.finding: Relies on Telegram native scheduled messages (including daily and weekly recurrence); takopi has no scheduler of its own.

evidence.title: Codex runner
evidence.finding: Runs codex app-server by default and answers approval requests with accept, permission requests with the requested scope and MCP elicitation with decline.

evidence.title: Claude runner
evidence.finding: Runs claude -p non-interactively; permissions must be preconfigured or dangerously_skip_permissions set; no interactive question handling.

evidence.title: Plugin API
evidence.finding: Entry-point plugins for engines, transports and commands.

evidence.title: Environment variables
evidence.finding: Only logging, non-interactive and Pi directory variables; no telemetry settings.

evidence.title: CI workflow
evidence.finding: CI runs ruff format and lint checks, ty type checking, pytest, uv build and a docs build, and notifies on commits.

evidence.title: takopi Claude runner usage payload
evidence.locator: _usage_payload; pi.py MessageEnd/AgentEnd usage; search of src/takopi for usage and cost
evidence.finding: The Claude runner copies total_cost_usd, duration, num_turns and usage from the result event into the completed event, and the Pi runner keeps the last message usage. A bounded search of src/takopi/*.py, telegram/ and presenter/markdown rendering found nowhere that displays, stores or exports it.
